claim: Open until lane 3.5a adds the house's tax basis (ADR 0359 C2) and flips this row to resolved. Any migration naming the setting as a whole word, in this record's spelling (tax_basis, reclaims_input_tax) or the cost-math plan's (reclaims_input_kdv), holds it, so the lane that builds it without flipping the row fails the build. cost_tax_basis does not match tax_basis as a whole word.

Open until lane 3.5a stamps each lot's cost with what it holds (ADR 0359 C3) and flips this row to resolved. Any migration naming the stamp as a whole word, as cost_tax_basis or as the local stack's unit_cost_tax_basis, holds it.

Open until lane 3.5b adds the dated, sourced tax rate table (ADR 0359 C5) and flips this row to resolved. Any migration naming it as a whole word, as tax_rate_bands, the cost-math plan's kdv_rate_bands or the local stack's house_tax_rates, holds it.

Open until lane 3.5b teaches margin advice the house's tax basis (ADR 0359 C4) and flips this row to resolved. On main no non-spec file under apps/api-gateway/src/pricing names tax (margin-to-target.ts:12 is (price - cost) / price). Any non-spec file there naming tax, VAT or KDV as its own word or identifier part (tax, taxes, taxable, tax_basis, taxBasis, priceTax, TAX_RATE, includesVat, kdvRate) holds it; words that only contain the letters, such as syntax, taxonomy, private or vatican, do not.
